This suggests the issue may be a payment method failure or something else, not a spending limit.

Wait, but the screenshot shows "Budgets and alerts" page. The Actions budget has $20/$100 spent. There's also a 100% badge for Codespaces. So maybe the issue is that the GitHub account payment method is failing, but the budget isn't exhausted.

Actually, the earlier CI failure reason was: "The job was not started because recent account payments have failed or your spending limit needs to be increased. Please check the 'Billing & plans' section in your settings"

This is a payment failure, not a budget exhaustion. The user is showing budget screen. Maybe they need to update payment method. The direct payment screen link would be the GitHub payment method page.

I should respond to the user: The screenshot shows you still have $80 of your $100 Actions budget left, so the blocker isn't a spending limit. The error message says "recent account payments have failed" — this usually means the card on file was declined or expired. You need to update/re-add the payment method on GitHub, not just the budget.

Let me provide the direct payment method link.

Also I need to be careful - the system_context says this is a new empty project? So I should respond about the payment method.
